recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染下，黑色細纖維在造血區內交織成網並包繞個別細胞（pericellular），形成細密格子狀，而非局限於血管周圍，代表網狀纖維增加（約 MF-1 至 2 級），常見於毛細胞白血病骨髓。
features: Increased black argyrophilic reticulin fibers forming a loose to dense meshwork within cellular marrow areas
Fibers encircle individual cells in a pericellular (chicken-wire) pattern
Numerous intersections of fibers without thick collagen bundles evident
Interspersed fat spaces with fibers outlining adipocyte borders
Cell nuclei appear dark; greenish-brown counterstain; photographic resolution and focus are limited
describe_en: Reticulin (silver) stain of the bone marrow core biopsy shows an increased network of fine black reticulin fibers with numerous intersections, wrapping around individual cells in a pericellular pattern within the cellular areas and outlining fat spaces. Coarse collagen bundles are not evident in this image, although resolution is limited. The fiber density corresponds approximately to grade MF-1 to MF-2. In the context of hairy cell leukemia, these findings reflect the characteristic pericellular reticulin fibrosis that often results in a dry tap aspirate.

ddx.vs: PMF fibrosis is accompanied by clustered atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes and often collagen and osteosclerosis, rather than fine pericellular fibers around a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate.
Normal reticulin is sparse, scattered linear fibers mainly perivascular without intersections, not a dense pericellular meshwork.
Mastocytosis shows fibrosis localized within paratrabecular or perivascular spindle mast-cell aggregates confirmed by tryptase/CD117, not diffuse pericellular fibers.
Desmoplastic carcinoma shows coarse collagenous fibrosis around cohesive epithelial nests that are keratin positive.
